Besides being able to communicate in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], the [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Pwi'lin]],<ref name="Tethan" /> who was active in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> also spoke another '''language''', which his [[Pwi'lin's first mate|first mate]] understood.<ref name="Tethan" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Errruka? Rindath con fa'alen deasant? Okay, poodarn.|Pwi'lin, speaking to his first mate in the language in an adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
[[File:Dyd2_bg.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Pwi'lin's language appeared in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''.]]
Pwi'lin's [[Language/Legends|language]] appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In an adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|protagonist]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], meets the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] Pwi'lin in a [[Unidentified Raidos cantina|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Raidos]] on the former's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]],<ref name="Tethan" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Unbeknownst to the youngling, Pwi'lin is an enslaver intending to capture and [[Slavery/Legends|sell]] them to a [[Unidentified mine owner|mine owner]] in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] settlement<ref name="Tethan" /> on the Outer Rim [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TEA" />

During a conversation between Pwi'lin and the Tethan, the former's first mate, who is supposedly repairing his [[Rindoon Dart|starship]] at the nearby [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], contacts him via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The enslaver then asks a pair of questions and gives a short statement to the first mate in his language, after which Pwi'lin tells the youngling about his [[Sandonian 4XA Prensile Cruiser|vessel]], going on to exploit the latter's interest in the [[Starship/Legends|craft]] to kidnap them at the spaceport.<ref name="Tethan" />
